title: Karbala mein aayi hoo
body:
mai chut ke shaam se ab karbala mein aayi hoo
tumhari qabr pe ashkon ka tohfa laayi hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari thi jo amanat mai usko laa na saki
usay tamachon ki zemhat se mai bacha na saki
mai uski qaid mein turbat bana ke aayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhara kurta siya tha jo amma zehra ne
wo jisko loot liya waqt e asr aada ne
mai shaam se wohi kurta bhi saath laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
lo aagayi hai ye khwahar utho utho bhaiya
mai aur chal nahi sakti sahara do bhaiya
rasool ki hoo nawasi falak satayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai hum bhare darbaar se guzaare gaye
ghazab to ye hai ke pathar bhi humko maare gaye
nishan e zakhm jabeen par saja ke laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
imam e waqt ye masoom abid e bemaar
har ek gaam pe jisne uthaye hai aazaar
mai jalte sholon se usko bacha ke laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mere aun o mohamed wo qasim o akbar
mai saath laayi hoo in sab ke bhi kate huwe sar
tumhara sar bhi badan se milaane laayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab uthi roti hui qabre sheh se binte ali
ye bain karti hui tab suye furaat chali
jo mujhpe guzri ay ghazi sunaane aayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo qabre shaah wo chehlum ka din wo zainab e zaar
ye nauha goonj raha tha ay majid o mukhtar
salaam karne shaheedon mai tumko aayi hoo
mai chut ke shaam se...
author: Majid Raza Abidi
